title: Craft Material Inventory
description: A local Craft Material Inventory workbench with a runnable initial core and a staged improvement roadmap.

steps.goal: Add case-insensitive search to Craft Material Inventory, using the domain fields material, quantity, and craft. Preserve existing behavior and return deterministic results for empty data.
